data.selection: Fixed unused Co-MoE corpus region; no selection by loss or routing
data.scoring: logits at position j predict reference token j+1; j=0..254 per context

protocol.replacement: Only layer-7 expert-0 raw output, before ORIGINAL mixture weight

controls.norm_matching: Random/scrambled projected response per selected row matches the pretrained projected response on that same input, before mixture weighting

runtime.loss_accumulation: float64 sum of float32 cross-entropy values

limitations: One literary text slice, one fixed expert pair, one draw per weight control
Unused in prior Co-MoE tests does not imply absence from model pretraining
Context resets limit available history; not a standard full-corpus perplexity score
Random/scrambled controls inherit the pretrained response norm, not its direction
No statistical superiority, general capability, or performance-speed claim
